cases.prompt: My Clay column returns null but the data is clearly there.
assert: checks field name casing before anything else
checks the action name and whether a company name was passed where a domain is required

cases.prompt: This pipeline worked last week and is blank now.
assert: names a provider response envelope change as the cause path
names one root cause rather than a list of possibilities

cases.prompt: Should I re run the table?
assert: never advises re running the full table; re runs on 10 rows after the cause is named
anchors: No advice to re run the full table
